pr_summary: Fix AttributeError when accessing logprobs attribute from Azure OpenAI chat completion choices. The issue is that Azure OpenAI responses may not include the logprobs field, causing an AttributeError when the code tries to access choice.logprobs directly. The fix uses getattr(choice, 'logprobs', None) to safely access the attribute.
